text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed failed GPU warmups in eu-west-1 after the VPC endpoint policy change. Nodes provisioning, but warm-pool init failing with S3 403s when fetching model artifacts and audit logs.
maya: Which policy change? I thought we only tightened egress for privatelink.
alex: Ops ran a KMS key-policy restrict earlier this morning and a VPC endpoint policy that denies s3:PutObject except from specific service principals. Stack trace: `s3.PutObject - AccessDenied: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-eu/*`.
jamie: That's the audit log sink bucket, right? If PutObject is blocked, logship won't upload startup logs so warmups retry then timeout.
lina: Impacted: all new warm-pool GPU nodes in eu-west-1; existing nodes fine. Cost note: provisioning retries increased GPU time ~+30% yesterday.
alex: Also saw model artifacts failing to fetch via internal-bucket because endpoint policy denied GetObject for the role used by bootstrap.
maya: Can we quickly allow s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject to the specific IAM role for node-bootstrap only? That would be least-priv.
jamie: Suggest temporary mitigate: add endpoint policy exception for IAM role `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/node-bootstrap` and for keystore KMS decrypt. Then audit the access after.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-438 - vpc-endpoint-s3-blocking-bootstraps. Pagerduty alert triggered to eng-infra oncall.
alex: Patch I started: 
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint_policy" "s3_bootstrap_exception" {
  vpc_endpoint_id = "vpce-0a1b2c3d"
  policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/node-bootstrap"},"Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-eu/*"}
  ]
}
POLICY
}
```
maya: +1 but we need a KMS allow too for decrypt on `alias/redwood-keystore-eu`.
alex: Added temporary KMS key policy snippet and applied. Monitoring now.
lina: After apply, warm-pool success rate went from 60%->98% in last 20m. Cost spike should normalize.
jamie: Follow-ups: (1) owner for long-term policy? infra-security. (2) audit: list all buckets impacted. (3) create canary that validates bootstrap S3+KMS access after policy changes.
maya: I'll file a PR to infra-security with the exception pattern and propose a more specific condition on `aws:SourceArn` to tighten. Also propose adding `s3:PutObjectAcl` if needed for log ownership.
alex: Thanks — adding notes to the incident and linking the PR. Reassigning to infra-security for policy review.
ops-bot: Incident updated: severity lowered to P2 — warmup regression mitigated.
